name: Toxic Fogger
summary: In Stonetalon, the Toxic Fogger is bound for Venture Company air routes. The Forsaken Royal Apothecary Society filled it with lethal poison to contaminate the company’s flights.

sections.title: A Forsaken Solution
sections.body:
Apothecary Zamah sends the Toxic Fogger against the Venture Company's mining work. Apothecary Lydon brewed its toxin in Tarren Mill, and Zamah sent it from Thunder Bluff. She suspects the goblins carry messages and light cargo between Stonetalon and their headquarters by courier flying machine.

Zamah plans to release the poison where those machines land and refuel. The Forsaken mean to strike the company's supply route instead of meeting its mercenary crews in drawn-out skirmishes.

sections.title: Sabotage at Cragpool Lake
sections.body:
The Toxic Fogger is meant for the Venture Company's copter pad near Cragpool Lake. The secluded landing site stands above the cleared hills and links distant crews with outside hubs. Its toxic vapor will spread across the staging ground and catch returning pilots unaware.

Some Horde may recoil at poison, but Zamah tells her agents to put guilt aside. She believes no method is too dark if it brings victory over the exploiters.

faq.q: What is the Toxic Fogger used for?
faq.answer: The Toxic Fogger is meant to poison the Venture Company's sky port at Cragpool Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains. Its vapor contaminates the light cargo and couriers bound for company headquarters.

Apothecary Lydon brewed the toxin in Tarren Mill from the blood of innocents. Apothecary Zamah, an envoy of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff, sent it for delivery.

faq.q: Where does the Toxic Fogger need to be placed?
aliases: where do i put the fogger
faq.answer: Place the Toxic Fogger atop the elevated Venture Company copter pad near Cragpool Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains, south of the large waterwheel.

faq.q: Why does the Horde resort to using poison against the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company's logging and mining ravage Stonetalon. Apothecary Zamah considers ordinary combat too slow, and believes the Horde must use ruthless methods to destroy the goblins before they cause irreparable harm.

angles.text: As an undead, you see the Royal Apothecary Society's field strategy at work: disrupt enemy supplies with airborne toxins and show allies that dark methods can bring results.
As a tauren, you may find lethal vapors at odds with traditional codes of honor. The Venture Company's damage to the land leads many in Thunder Bluff to tolerate Zamah's harsh measures.
